initiate_disclaimer:
The 'Help' button in the app's header is adaptive! Click it on any page and you will get information for that specific page.

Note though that the button is disabled in some pages where no information is available (yet).
initiate_info:
Welcome to Laneh.

Please create a server admin user and a household.

The user will automatically be part of the household. You can add more users and households later.

Alternatively, you can import a database dump from a previous server instance.

shopping_add_items_help:
Write the item names that you want to add. Write one name per row. You can add more rows with the 'Plus' button.

The 'Tab' or 'Enter' keys can be used to navigate from amount to name or to navigate into the next row. If no next row exists, a new one will be created automatically.

The amount column is optional. It can be filled with any string like '2kg' or '5 cans'.

If any name is similar to an item you've added in the past, they will be autocorrected before you save. This correction can be reverted, if you want.
